关于我的一些事(Something about Me): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
We often go to the supermarket together.
I often play baseball after class.
I like my life very much.
The gift box is not far from my home.
My friend Ben is very kind.
The pizza has extra cheese on top.
